notes.title: Mystic Mayhem Unleashed Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35527692/9fbfcc38e6a1712e2eb4632f1b28ba2fb72812dc.png[/img]

The [i][b]Mystic Mayhem Unleashed Demo[/b][/i] is now available to download on Steam. 
You can now try the game before you buy. 

[b]Do you have what it takes to save the island?[/b]

No you can try with 6 levels in the demo edition of Mystic Mayhem Unleashed.
Thwart Malwarp's army of Minions and make your way to saving Princess Parsley.

Check it out!

notes.title: Update Version 2.1.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35527692/54ee4a69f13838fdb72786ef3e3a5dfe211dd316.png[/img]

Hi All!

There were also new updates (Version 2.1.3) added to the demo and full version of the game. These include:

– Fixed End Level Stats “Press Any Key to Continue” timing. Also added timer if no response in 20 seconds it continues to map page.

– [Full version] Fixed final boss 2nd lazer attack timing.

– Increased wizard minion health.

– Updated player animations timing/response on final boss level.

notes.title: Update Version 2.1.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35527692/432ff26efc3dd9654b4f823b4ac84a4a0bc003e5.png[/img]

Hi Everyone!

There are some updates for the release version 2.1.2 of Mystic Mayhem Unleashed.
Updates include:

    [list]
[*]     Added another path to leave after getting key (level 11)
[*]     Fixed log placement (level 33)
[*]     Fixed end path placement (level 34).
[*]     Fixed sprockets/cogs velocity change on player (level 17 + others).
[*]     Fixed jump box (trampoline box) high jump.
[*]     End Stats Screen can now be skipped early (after pic of Max shows).
[*]     Added path on level select map screen to show level 30 goes to 31.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Version 2.1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35527692/2d460e9fd09244be4737fb9353fa66ff45dc8877.jpg[/img]
Hi Everyone!

There are some updates for the release version 2.1.1 of Mystic Mayhem Unleashed.
Updates include:

    [list]
[*] Fixed Animation (Level 17)
[*] Fixed Enemy placement (levels 17, 23, 25).
[*] Fixed wall crawl speed.
[*] Added new platforms Level 27.
[*] Fixed jump ability on rotating platforms (Level 23)
[/list]

notes.title: Update Version 2.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35527692/f15c78235a16b6b308df94066f95a7834978c2c7.jpg[/img]

Hi Everyone!

There are some updates for both the Demo and Release version of Mystic Mayhem Unleashed.
Updates include:

- Fixed Enemy placement (levels 22, 24).
- Updated Pixel Shader for Saws.
- Fixed wall climbing collision detection.
- Fixed enemy placement (levels 20, 22, 25).
- Updated Stats Info exit time.
- Updated some designs in levels 22,23,24,31,33


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35527692/e5b616181438ef121ac47ef79ac6fa4aa1dcddec.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Version 2.0.0
notes.notes:
Hi All!

There are some updates for both the Demo and Release version of Mystic Mayhem Unleashed.
Updates include:

- Fixed Enemy placement (levels 6, 12, 15, 16).
- Fixed star placement (Level 18).
- Fixed player start placement, now has a ledge (Level 15).
- Mouse cursor auto hides during game.
- Extended pop up saw detection size.
- Fixed flame mana actions (multilevel)

notes.title: Mystic Mayhem Unleashed is now available!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Mystic Mayhem Unleashed is now available for purchase on Steam. 
Thanks to everyone to help make it possible. 

If you want to find out more, you can play the demo on 
[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/mystic-mayhem-unleashed-demo/424952]Mystic Mayhem Unleashed Demo on GameJolt[/url]

You can learn more about it and see updates on BitCore Studios website:
